Involvement

Act Three

Cillian stands near the northern corner of the Sharess' Caress building, and is talking to  Surixana. It was recommended that he buy a certain medicine from her to provide a certain kind of "pleasurable assistance". However, he is quite uneasy about exposing his need to a stranger, feeling embarrassed at the prospect of naming it for what it is.

Idle banter

  • Cillian
    This is safe to take - you're absolutely sure?
  • Surixana
    My good man, every substance has been tried and tested by yours truly.
  • Cillian
    What - what does it feel like?
  • Surixana
    In a word, sir? Exquisite. Almost painfully so. My body burned like the noonday sun.
  • Cillian
    And the... other person with you - they enjoyed it?
  • Surixana
    Enjoyed it? Sir, I had no less than two maidens and a bachelor clawing at my door the very next morn.
  • Cillian
    How long do the effects last?
  • Surixana
    It depends on the person, and their virility. For you, I'd recommend two doses.
  • Cillian
    Two? That seems like a lot.
  • Surixana
    Do you not wish to pleasure your fine maiden? To feel her fingers grip yours in pure ecstacy?
  • Cillian
    Shhh - people will hear.
  • Surixana
    Good - let them see you taking charge of your pleasurable destiny.
  • Surixana
    I sense some hesitation in you - speak, good sir.
  • Cillian
    It's just embarassing to need something like this.
  • Surixana
    Whatever for? Does the hand not assist the lips? The lips the tongue? If your mighty mast needs -
  • Cillian
    I got it! I got it - and thanks.
  • Surixana
    Of course. Set your worries at ease - you're in safe hands.
